title: El Moro de Sabinas, MEXI STORIES
comment: moro-sabinas (MEXI): caballeriza de un rancho ganadero en Sabinas Hidalgo, Nuevo León, por la mañana. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.MARLENE_SALINAS: Mexican woman, young widow of a powerful rancher, now owner of the ranch, 36 years old, fair skin, long platinum-blonde dyed hair in loose waves, heavy eyeliner, glossy pink lips, a fitted black satin blouse, tight white jeans, expensive beige suede boots, large gold earrings, her hands empty.
chars.DARIO_LOZANO: Mexican man, the ranch administrator and the widow's secret lover, 41 years old, light-brown skin, slicked-back black hair, a groomed black beard, a smug look, a fitted burgundy polo shirt, dark jeans, a big silver belt buckle, a gold watch, his hands empty.
chars.TOBIAS_GUERRA: Mexican man, newly hired stable hand, 58 years old, dark weathered skin, grey hair under an old sweat-stained straw cowboy hat, a grey mustache, calm intelligent grey eyes, a faded denim shirt with rolled sleeves, worn jeans, old boots, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_CABALLERIZASABINAS: Old wooden horse stable of a cattle ranch in Sabinas Hidalgo, Nuevo Leon, in the bright morning: wooden stalls, hay bales, saddles on racks, dusty sunbeams through the slats, a beautiful black horse in an open stall, a wide doorway onto a dry ranch yard and hills, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
